summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for iteration 2 of Car Trading Ireland (Sell Your Car submissions, Contact messages, admin overview stats, admin submissions workflow, admin messages, and regression on cars/uploads). All 23 backend pytest tests PASS. All 5 frontend flows PASS (contact submit, sell submit, browse+detail, admin overview with stats/sidebar badges, admin submissions workflow with status update + drawer, admin messages read/unread flow, admin listings regression).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py compress_image converts to JPEG but stores at path with .jpg regardless of original ext — MIME_TYPES dict is dead code for non-fallback path (minor).
storage_key is a module-level mutable global refreshed via globals() reassign — works, but a small StorageClient class would be cleaner.
Login endpoint sets cookie with samesite='none' + secure=True which is correct for cross-site preview URL; ensure production origin runs over HTTPS (currently OK).
Overview.jsx does not show a loading skeleton — during initial mount metric values render as '—'; consider a shimmer. Non-blocking.
AdminLayout redirect flow: unauthenticated /admin routes go to /admin/login rather than /login — works but two login pages exist visually. Consider consolidating.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_ submission (auto-cleaned in test), 1 TEST_ contact message (auto-cleaned), plus UI_TEST_ contact + UI_TEST_ Seller submission via UI (still present in DB — not auto-cleaned).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_car_trading.py (pytest, 23 tests). Frontend admin routes require login via /login or /admin/login (both mount Login.jsx). Token stored in localStorage 'ct_token' + Authorization Bearer header. Cookies also set. All data-testids referenced in review_request are present and functional. Iteration 2 shipped without regressions on iteration 1 features.
